395: def _nested_pair(tensor, mod, reading, label):
396:     """Apply the AMB-02 inner bracket on the two trailing slots, or not."""
397:     if reading == "outer":
398:         return tensor
399:     if reading != "nested":
400:         raise ValueError(f"unknown reading {reading!r}")
401:     program = BracketProgram(
402:         ops=[BracketOp("antisym", (4, 5), BLACK, True, label)], source=label)
403:     return program.apply(tensor, mod)
